'''Hawk Leader''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial pilot (Sith Empire)|Imperial pilot]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He led [[Hawk Squadron (Sith Empire)|Hawk Squadron]] while stationed at [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Hawk Leader and Hawk Squadron attempted several bombing runs on [[Camp Conquest|Outpost Victory]] before its shields were finally taken down.
